title: Research: odd-cardinality cheaper readout collapses under dirty-parity repair (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Answers open question 1 of [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686) in the five-source common-B mutable-source alphabet of [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898).

Define the natural **all-subset** (odd-cardinality allowed) connector-state readout score on Q=7 walks. Free of dirty-cancellation, it reaches **R=66** (spectrum `{66,72}` on distinct-6 covers; one-repeat layer `R=80`) and would tariff **410 < 436** at `X=6`. But odd live-connector `R_m` counts leave arbitrary connector dirt on those outputs. The minimal **zero-slot parity repair** restores even live-connector parity and collapses every covering schedule to even-subset cost **R≥82** (tariff **442**), matching #2686.

| Readout model | Distinct-6 min R | One-repeat R | Tariff at X=6 | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| All-subset (free, illegal dirt) | **66** | 80 | **410** | yes (not legal) |
| Even-subset (#2686) | 82 | 96 | 442 | no |
| Parity-repaired odd sets | **82** | 96 | **442** | **no** |

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2687](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2687) (including [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686), [#2677](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2677), [#2643](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2643), [#2593](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2593)) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction/`.
Tip: `5f188dcf6c5043b65a3205cf1f8fdcea7dc98fd6`.

Exact: free all-subset min R **66** (hypothetical tariff **410**); after dirty-parity repair min R **82** (tariff **442**); no legal undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_CHEAPER_READOUT_7Q_OBSTRUCTION all_subset_min_R=66 parity_repair_min_R=82 hypothetical_tariff=410 repair_tariff=442 no_undercut_after_dirty_parity_repair answers_7qr_oq1 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_CHEAPER_READOUT_7Q covering=583296 all_min=66 repair_min=82 tariff_free=410 tariff_repair=442 answers_7qr_oq1 no_new_kappa
PASS_CHEAPER_READOUT_7Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/cheaper-readout-7q-obstruction outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2686) even-subset R floor (OQ1). Freestanding; no competing open PR on this all-subset/parity-repair obstruction at refresh.
